text.tspan: Q. what is ADD in dockerfile? and what is diff between ADD and COPY?
=> ADD same like copy for most cases but Add can use to dowload from url or extract
=> Your application whole code wrapped inside single executable file which is made of layers
from where each layer is each command from dockerfile
Q. What is diff between docker stop and docker kill?
=> docker stop gracefully shutdown container where docker kill, stops container.
Stop gives grace period for cleanup
STOP => SIGTERM => waits for grace period => if process is still running => SIGKILL

g.text: # → docker run my-app runs: node server.js
# → docker run my-app bash runs: bash (CMD replaced!)
# → docker run my-app server.js runs: node server.js
# → docker run my-app runs: node server.js
# → docker run my-app other.js runs: node other.js (CMD replaced, ENTRYPOINT fixed)

text.tspan: When you build a production app, your build process needs a lot of tools:
But your running app needs almost none of that. It just needs the final compiled output.
Each stage becomes temporary image and final stage becomes main image
ARG => stays during build time only, also can be declared only ex. ARG port.
ENV => stays at the build time till container run time. Also needs to be initialized
ex. ENV port=80. Drops footprint in docker inspect
-e => best for secrets that can't be exposed
